name: University of Agriculture, Faisalabad (UAF)
_note: Weights from the official 'Details/Advertisement of Undergraduate Admissions 2026-27' (Urdu, p. 1): admission on Matric 30% + Intermediate Part-I 30% + entry test 40%; entry test mandatory; pass marks 33% (Agricultural Engineering & Technology faculty), 50% (DVM, Pharm-D), none for other programs (p. 2). Merit lists are ~1,400 candidate-wise PDFs (web.uaf.edu.pk/Downloads/MeritListsView); no closing figures stored. uaf.edu.pk sends an incomplete TLS chain.
